build_note: jax-gcm#1017 W5: rebuilt with JAX_ENABLE_X64=1 set before this process's first jax import. read_obrien_gcr_ipr's own jnp.asarray(...) at the end of the table read freezes to float32 if jax_enable_x64 is not already True AT THAT CALL; the ORIGINAL build of this file did not enable it anywhere, so its table (and therefore gcr_table.bin and out/pgcripr) was silently float32-rounded despite the float64 container. in/vertical_cutoff_rigidity, in/mass_column_density, in/ipr_solmin and in/ipr_solmax now match a live read_obrien_gcr_ipr(HAM_INPUT_DIR) call bit-for-bit (np.array_equal, verified at rebuild time).
